arStrings.szText: Ultimate Skill: Create a Clone of yourself.
You gain {c_important}{u}Stealth{/u}{/c} and {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{buffduration:UNSTOPPABLE}{/c} seconds after casting {c_important}Shadow Clone{/c}.
{c_important}Shadow Clone{/c} engulfs you in its visage granting {c_number}[SF_7*100|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction for the duration.
